contexts.text: Thus all the rites of the Ancient and of the Jewish Church were types representative of the Lord. AC 1038:8. AC 1736:2. AC 2005:end. AC 2807:2.
Those who worshipped... rituals, etc., and separated them from internal things, are sons of Ham, AC 1162:2. AC 1167. AC 1172:end.
Sons of Japheth = those who knew no other doctrinals than external rites.
(These nations) = so many doctrinals, which were the same as rituals, which they observed holily. Illustrated. AC 1152. AC 1154. AC 1156.
Rituals representative of spiritual things. Signified.
Rituals corresponding to internal worship. Signified. AC 2576:8.
(These nations) = the rituals, etc., which are of faith separated from charity.
Dedan = the Knowledges of lower celestial things which are in rituals.
Exterior goods which are of worship, or of rituals. Signified.
These doctrinals they distinguish from rituals. Example(s).
(These nations) = so many rituals... of external worship.
The things born of scientifics through ratiocinations are nothing but rituals. Signified.
So many rituals which are mere scientifics. Signified, Explained.

The rituals of that worship, being from reasonings and scientifics, are called scientific rituals, in which there is nothing spiritual and celestial, because from self. Hence the idols and magic of the Egyptians. And as their rituals came thence, they totally rejected the rites of the Ancient Church. Illustrated.
As their scientifics were diverse, the derivative rituals also became diverse.
Doctrinals of rituals from a like origin. Signified.
To other rituals they began to prefer sacrifices, which were unknown in the Ancient Church...
(These nations) = so many rituals... which are unknown.
Doctrinals which are rituals. Signified. See AC 1348.
The rituals of such worship. Signified. AC 1352.
Stewardship pertains to the External Church; as the administration of rituals...

So very many rites in the Ancient Church, and Jewish Church, which in themselves were nothing but rituals containing no truth, were tolerated and permitted, nay, commanded, because they were accounted holy by their parents, and thus were implanted and impressed as truths on their minds from infancy. Signified.
Sacrifices and like rites then ceased.
Signs of the covenant were all the rites of the External Church, which were to be kept holily, because internal things were signified by them. Circumcision was nothing but a representative rite.
As all the rites of that Church = internal things, so this cleansing. AC 3147:9, Explained.
(Thus) there were heavenly arcana in every rite, especially in the sacrifices...
(The Holy Supper supposed to be a mere rite.)
The Hebrew Church... placed some holy worship in external rites.
(The Israelites) did not know what the rites represented.
Unless these things had been as if present to the Angels... through all the rites in the Jewish Church...
The Israelites, with whom the representative rite of the Ancient Church had been introduced...
Exterior Knowledges are those of the rituals and doctrinals of the External Church.
The Most Ancients had many rites from this, of which one was that they placed the hand under the thigh when they were pledged to any good of conjugial love. (See ).
(Such) observed this rite as an idolatrous one.
Their doctrinals and rituals varied, but still there was one Church.
The externals of the Church are rituals: the internals are doctrinals when these are of the life.
Statutes = the externals of the Word, such as rituals...
The opinion of the Jews concerning the rituals of their Church.
As that nation... thus could have holy rituals...
That companions are not to be defrauded of external truths, which are doctrinals... and rituals. Signified. AC 3693:6.
(This) is evident from an internal understanding of the rituals of the Ancient Church.
This ritual represented the will of faith... This ritual was holy...
This custom... was derived from the Ancient Church, whose worship consisted in rituals, which were representative...
The rituals themselves of (the Jewish) Church, relatively to them, were idolatrous, because they were separated from internals.
It was a ritual that those who entered into a covenant should pass the night in one place. Explained.
As this ritual was holy, signifying initiation, the wise men brought presents.
In both (a representative Church and a representative of a Church) there are nearly similar external rituals, namely, similar statutes, laws, and precepts. (The difference explained.)

The externals of the Church are like the body... as the altars and sacrifices, the show breads, the candlestick, the perpetual fire, which represented internal things; in like manner the rest of the rites. AC 4429:2.
Interior truth... is that truth which was the internal of the Church with the Ancients... in their statutes, judgments, and laws; in a word, in their rituals and the like.
For the rituals instituted with the (Israelites) were externals which represented the internals which were of the Most Ancient Church.
When any arcanum is represented by a ritual, each single thing of that ritual, until it is completed, involves something of that arcanum.
(Thus) by the rituals here mentioned are signified spiritual and celestial things...
(Thus) the rituals commanded the Israelites were holy (merely because) they represented holy things.
(The origin of the ritual of erecting a statue.)

All these rituals (at coronations) derived their origin from the Most Ancient times, when rituals were holy from their representing and corresponding to the holy things in Heaven and thence in the Church.
They knew that all the rituals and externals of their (Ancient) Church represented Him.
The Church is not the Church from externals, that is, from rituals... for these are only the formal things.
The Knowledges and scientifics (of the Ancients) were to Know what the rituals of their Church represented...
The rituals which are with us from ancient times; as the rituals of betrothals, etc.
Therefore the ritual of crying out was received among the Ancients.
The scientifics of the Church (then) were the representatives and significatives of rituals; for all the rituals of the Church were from such things.
Hence, when they were to be blessed, this external ritual was strictly to be observed.
(This) was a ritual received from the Ancients.
From that ancient time, the same ritual (of the laying of the right hand upon the head) remains to this day, and is in use in inaugurations, and in blessings.
The external of the Church is to perform rituals holily, and to do the works of charity according to the precepts of the Church.
It is then not worship, but a rite which appears like worship. AC 8680:end.

For the rituals and statutes commanded the (Israelites) were not new, but had existed before in the Ancient Churches, and were only restored... because with other nations they had become idolatrous and magical.
The Egyptians knew the representations of spiritual things in natural ones, which then constituted the rituals of the Church.
Pottage = the good of the external rituals of the Jewish Church.
The rites of the Jewish Church... in the external form were truths and goods... because they represented...
(The ritual of sitting among the Israelites. Explained.)
For every ritual with the Israelites was only a representative...
For no one is condemned on account of the omission of external rituals...
All the process of regeneration is described by all the several rituals of each sacrifice and burnt-offering.
For all the rituals of worship instituted with (that) nation regarded the Lord only. AC 10370, Explained.
The rites (of the Ancient Church), and also the statutes, according to which their worship was instituted, consisted of mere correspondences...
The abolition of the representative rites of the Jewish Church. Signified.
